title: chore: move parser helpers next to their users
body: Phase 1 imported `disallow_children` from phase 2, `fuzzymatch` sat in the parser's utils while only analysis and `extract_svelte_ignore` used it, `create_fragment` had a file to itself although `create_attribute` lives in `phases/nodes.js`, and `push_array` had a single caller. Each now sits next to its users: `create_fragment` and `disallow_children` in `phases/nodes.js`, `fuzzymatch` in `compiler/utils`, `push_array` inside `mapped_code.js`. Four files fewer, no behaviour change.
